headline: Anthropic grants METR employee-level access to audit its AI practices
summary: Anthropic gave outside researchers at METR employee-level access to its systems, giving up the right to block METR's own assessments of its risks, incidents, and practices. One report called it an industry first for third-party AI auditing, noting external evaluators play a crucial role as AI labs continue to self-regulate.
